Location: South Korea | Remote
Engagement: Freelance / Independent Contractor | Project-Based | Part-Time
About the Project
We are looking for English-speaking Image Quality Evaluators based in South Korea to support AI training and evaluation projects.
You will review images and assess their quality according to project guidelines, helping improve the accuracy and performance of AI systems.
You do not need to be Korean. We welcome applicants of any nationality who are currently living in South Korea, have lived there for several years, and are highly familiar with Korean culture, everyday life, and local context.
What You'll Do
• Evaluate images based on quality standards and project guidelines.
• Identify issues such as blur, poor lighting, noise, exposure, compression, and framing.
• Evaluate visual content with awareness of South Korean cultural and local context.
• Accurately describe and interpret images in English.
• Maintain high accuracy, consistency, and productivity.
• Flag unusual cases or data-quality issues to the project team.
Requirements
• Currently residing in South Korea.
• Legally authorized to work as an independent contractor in South Korea.
• Have a South Korean bank account in your own name to receive payments.
• Have lived in South Korea for several years and have strong familiarity with Korean culture and local context.
• English: C1 level or above.
• Strong attention to detail and ability to follow detailed guidelines.
• Laptop/desktop and reliable internet connection.
• Previous experience in AI, data annotation, transcription, QA, or content evaluation is a plus, but not required.
Nationality is not a requirement. Local knowledge and lived experience in South Korea are.

Please mention the word **FUTURESTIC** and tag RNzQuMjQ5Ljc5LjUx when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RNzQuMjQ5Ljc5LjUx). This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.

127e54da91fb4af5.description:
We’re looking for an Associate Product Manager who wants to build products, not just manage roadmaps. Someone who is curious about why users behave the way they do, loves numbers, moves fast, and can turn a messy problem into a simple product experience.

What You’ll Do

• Own product problems end-to-end, from identifying the opportunity to launching, measuring, and iterating on the solution.
• Dive into user behaviour, product data, funnels, cohorts, and metrics to understand what’s working and what isn’t.
• Work closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Growth and Operations to take ideas from a whiteboard to production.
• Design and run experiments, A/B tests and product iterations to improve engagement, retention, monetisation and overall user experience.
• Spend time understanding our users, their motivations, habits, pain points and what keeps them coming back.
• Break large, ambiguous problems into clear, actionable product initiatives.
• Track product metrics and build a strong understanding of what moves the needle and why.
• Bring new ideas to the table by studying consumer products, emerging trends and unconventional product experiences.
• Move quickly, test, learn, ship, and improve.

What We’re Looking For

• 1–3 years of experience in Product Management, preferably at a high-growth consumer internet startup.
• Graduate from a Tier 1 institute with strong academic and analytical fundamentals.
• Someone who is comfortable with numbers, data and metrics.
• Strong understanding of product metrics, funnels, cohorts, retention and experimentation.
• Sharp problem-solving skills and the ability to structure ambiguous problems.
• High ownership and bias for action, you don't wait for perfect information to get started.
• Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with engineers, designers and business teams.
• A natural curiosity about consumer behaviour, social products, entertainment and mobile-first experiences.

Note: The FRND team works 6 days a week, with the 1st and 3rd Saturdays being working days.

About FRND

FRND is redefining the way people connect by building social products that are engaging, safe, inclusive, and fun.

We’re a rapidly growing startup building for millions of users and solving unique challenges across social connection and entertainment. Our ambition is bold, and we're looking for people who want to build, experiment, and solve problems at scale.

Why FRND?

🌍 Impact at Scale: Work on products and initiatives that impact millions of users across India and international markets.
🚀 High Ownership: Take on meaningful problems and have the freedom to drive them from idea to execution.
🧠 Learn with the Best: Work closely with founders, leaders, and high-performing teams while solving real business challenges.
💼 Rewarding Journey: Competitive compensation, equity opportunities, and growth that matches your impact.
🎉 Work Hard, Have Fun: We're serious about building great products, but we also believe in enjoying the journey along the way.
💡 Solve Interesting Problems: Work in an environment where curiosity, experimentation, and first-principles thinking are encouraged.

About the Company
HyperVerge is one of India's leading identity verification and digital onboarding platforms, helping enterprises onboard users seamlessly through AI-powered verification, compliance, and workflow automation solutions. Our products power customer onboarding journeys across banking, financial services, fintech, insurance, and other regulated industries.

About the Role
We are looking for a highly motivated and analytically driven Associate Product Manager to join our product team. In this role, you will work closely with product leaders, engineering teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to build and improve B2B enterprise products that solve meaningful customer problems at scale. This role is ideal for someone who has experience working in B2B SaaS and enterprise environments, enjoys solving complex customer problems, and can work closely with engineering teams to drive product development and execution. We are particularly interested in candidates with a strong technical foundation, including those who have transitioned from software engineering into product management, as well as candidates who have experience building technically complex products or taking products/features from 0→1.

Responsibilities

Product Discovery & Analysis
• Analyze product usage, customer feedback, and operational data to identify opportunities for improvement.
• Understand enterprise customer journeys, uncover pain points, and recommend solutions that drive better outcomes.
• Conduct customer and stakeholder discovery to understand business requirements and product opportunities.
• Monitor product performance and track key business and product metrics.

Product Development & Execution
• Own and support the end-to-end product development lifecycle, from problem definition to launch and iteration.
• Write clear and actionable PRDs, product requirements, user stories, and functional specifications.
• Work closely with engineering teams to translate customer and business problems into scalable product solutions.
• Partner with engineering, design, and QA teams to ensure successful execution of product initiatives.
• Define rollout plans, success metrics, edge cases, and post-launch evaluation frameworks.
• Contribute to 0→1 product and feature development.

Stakeholder & Customer Collaboration
• Work closely with enterprise customers and internal teams to gather requirements and understand business needs.
• Translate customer insights into product improvements and roadmap recommendations.
• Act as a bridge between product, engineering, business, operations, and external stakeholders.
• Build a strong understanding of customer workflows and business contexts to drive product decisions.

Product Performance & Optimization
• Track product health, user engagement, and operational performance through dashboards and reporting tools.
• Conduct root-cause analysis on product issues and work with engineering teams to drive resolution.
• Support experimentation, funnel analysis, and optimization initiatives to improve product outcomes.
• Use data and customer feedback to identify opportunities for product improvements.

Technical & Product Thinking
• Work closely with engineering teams on technically complex product problems.
• Develop an understanding of APIs, integrations, system workflows, and platform architecture.
• Evaluate technical trade-offs and translate complex technical concepts into clear product requirements.
• Identify opportunities to improve product scalability, reliability, and customer experience.

Market & Industry Awareness
• Stay informed about industry trends, customer expectations, emerging technologies, and competitive developments.
• Monitor competitor offerings and identify opportunities to strengthen product capabilities.
• Develop a strong understanding of relevant industry and enterprise workflows.

Qualifications

Education
• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related field.
• MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification is a plus.
• Strong academic background from a reputed institution is preferred.

Experience
• 1–3 years of experience in Product Management, APM, Product Ownership, Engineering, Consulting, Business Analytics, or related roles.
• B2B SaaS / B2B enterprise product experience is mandatory.
• Experience working with enterprise customers or enterprise-facing products.
• Demonstrated experience owning features or products through the product lifecycle.
• Experience working closely with engineering teams on technical products.
• Exposure to fintech, financial services, payments, identity, infrastructure, or other technology-driven industries is preferred.

Required Skills
• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
• Strong product thinking and ability to identify and structure ambiguous problems.
• Comfortable working with data, dashboards, product metrics, and analytics.
• Strong technical understanding and ability to collaborate effectively with engineering teams.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to work effectively with cross-functional and external stakeholders.
• Strong ownership mindset and attention to detail.
• Ability to understand enterprise customer problems and translate them into product solutions.
• Curiosity to understand how complex technology products and systems work.

Preferred Skills
• Started your career as a Software Engineer/Developer and transitioned into Product Management.
• Experience building or launching a product/feature from 0→1.
• Experience working on technically deep products involving APIs, integrations, infrastructure, identity, security, AI/ML, or platform products.
• Experience working with enterprise B2B SaaS customers.
• Experience in fintech, banking, brokerage, payments, lending, or financial services.
• Familiarity with experimentation, funnel analysis, and conversion optimization.
• Experience working in fast-paced, high-growth environments.

Why Join HyperVerge?
• Work on products that impact millions of users across industries.
• Build and scale B2B enterprise products solving meaningful customer problems.
• Learn directly from experienced product leaders and work closely with engineering and cross-functional teams.
• Gain exposure to product strategy, analytics, technical product development, execution, and customer problem-solving.
• Own meaningful product outcomes from day one.
• Get the opportunity to work on 0→1 product initiatives and technically complex product problems.
• Be part of a fast-growing company solving critical problems through technology and innovation.

123b1e983b58dc28.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

Overview of the Role

GitLab.com is being rebuilt as a horizontally scalable cluster. Two primitives make that possible: Organizations, the tenant boundary that makes a customer's data a single addressable, portable unit, and Cells, independent GitLab instances that host those Organizations and can be provisioned on demand across clouds and regions.

The target is a 100x increase in headroom for GitLab.com, delivered without customers ever seeing a cell. Same domain, same URLs, same product — a substrate underneath that scales by adding capacity rather than by negotiating with a single database.

The boundary we are building is worth more than the scale it unlocks. An isolated Organization can guarantee where its data lives and what travels with it. That turns data residency, regional control, in-region AI and search compute, and enforceable tenant-level policy into product capabilities rather than deployment exceptions. It is the foundation for a class of enterprise and regulated-market offerings that a shared-instance architecture cannot support.

We are hiring a Director of Engineering in India to lead this charter. You will build and run the engineering organization that takes Cells from first production migrations to the default way GitLab.com operates.

What you will do

  • Delivery of the Cells and Organizations roadmap — cell provisioning and lifecycle, the routing and topology layer, organization data migration tooling, and feature parity across the platform.
  • Migration execution. Cohort-based movement of customer Organizations onto cells with zero data loss, verified rollback, and no downtime outside the tenant in flight.
  • A multi-cloud, multi-region cell footprint and the architectural decisions that govern what stays cell-local and what crosses boundaries.
  • The engineering organization. Hire, level, and develop managers and senior ICs across several teams. Set the technical bar and the operating cadence.
  • Cross-functional leadership. This charter touches nearly every product group at GitLab. You will drive commitments and sequencing with peer engineering leaders, Product, Infrastructure, and Security — much of it asynchronously, across time zones, in public issues and merge requests.

How success is measured

  • Customer Organizations running on cells in production, migrated cleanly and on schedule.
  • Availability and latency improvements attributable to isolation and load distribution.
  • Infrastructure cost per unit of capacity trending down as the footprint grows.
  • Throughput and retention of the teams you build.

What you will bring

Engineering leadership at director scale

  • Experience leading multiple teams through managers (roughly 25–60 engineers), including hiring and developing managers.
  • A track record of shipping multi-quarter infrastructure programs with hard external dependencies — the kind where the hardest problem is sequencing across ten teams, not writing the code.
  • Comfort operating as a peer to VPs and staff-plus engineers: you can hold an architectural position on technical merit and change it when the evidence changes.
  • Strong written communication. GitLab is remote and asynchronous by default; influence here is exercised in documents.

Distributed systems depth

  • You have built and operated large-scale distributed systems in production — multi-tenant SaaS, sharded or cell-based architectures, control planes, or data platforms at comparable scale.
  • Working fluency in relational database scaling (partitioning, sharding, replication), data migration at scale, and request routing.
  • Real operational experience: incident command, capacity planning, and designing for blast-radius containment.
  • Cloud infrastructure at depth on at least one major provider, ideally more than one.

AI-native engineering

  • You understand what agentic access patterns do to a platform's read volume, concurrency, and authorization model, and you design for that rather than retrofitting it.
  • You use AI tooling in your own engineering practice and have raised the bar for it across a team.

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off 
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental Leave 

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions …
